# Projectile motion
Launch speed and angle are the inputs. Everything below is derived from them, with units carried through. Change $v_0$ or $\theta$ and watch the plot and the numbers update.
Position as a function of time. Note that `t` is left undefined, so `y(t)` is a real function of a symbolic variable.
y(t) = v_0 sin(theta) t - 1/2 g t^2
Time of flight, range and maximum height. `solve` works on the symbolic form; the numeric value follows.
Velocity is the derivative of position. `diff` acts on the symbolic expression, and the unit comes out as m/s.
